name: xray-cloud
description: Manage Xray Cloud tests, test sets, plans, executions and runs through a zero-install Python MCP server.

XRAY_CLIENT_ID.title: Xray client ID
XRAY_CLIENT_ID.description: Xray Cloud API key client ID (Jira: Apps, Xray, API Keys).

XRAY_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Xray client secret
XRAY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Xray Cloud API key client secret.

XRAY_REGION.title: Xray region
XRAY_REGION.description: Xray Cloud region: global, eu or au. Leave empty to use the XRAY_REGION environment variable (default global).

XRAY_SETTINGS_FILE.title: Settings file
XRAY_SETTINGS_FILE.description: Optional explicit path to the Xray settings file (YAML or JSON) listing projects and fields.

XRAY_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
XRAY_READ_ONLY.description: Optional. Set to true to make every write tool refuse to run. Leave empty to use the XRAY_READ_ONLY environment variable (default false).

XRAY_TOOLS.title: Tool groups
XRAY_TOOLS.description: Optional. Comma-separated tool groups; leave empty for all tools.

JIRA_SITE_URL.title: Jira site URL
JIRA_SITE_URL.description: Jira site URL, needed together with the Jira email and API token; leave all three empty to use the environment variables. Example: https://yourcompany.atlassian.net

JIRA_EMAIL.title: Jira email
JIRA_EMAIL.description: Email of the Jira account the API token belongs to; needed together with the Jira site URL and API token.

JIRA_API_TOKEN.title: Jira API token
JIRA_API_TOKEN.description: Jira API token, needed together with the Jira site URL and the email of its account; leave all three empty to use the environment variables.
